details.description: Gemma 2 9B-IT is a 9-billion-parameter, instruction-tuned, decoder-only text model in Google's second-generation Gemma family, trained on 8 trillion tokens of web documents, code and mathematical text. It takes text input and produces English text output. Google's current Gemma documentation groups Gemma 2, together with Gemma 1 and Gemma 3, under a "Legacy Gemma setup" section, with Gemma 4 presented as the current flagship generation.
advantages: Scores 71.3 on MMLU (5-shot), per Google's Gemma 2 9B-it model card.
Scores 81.9 on HellaSwag (10-shot), per the model card.
Scores 40.2 (pass@1) on HumanEval for code generation, per the model card.
Scores 68.6 (5-shot) on GSM8K grade-school math, per the model card.
disadvantages: Google's Gemma documentation groups this Gemma 2 family, along with Gemma 1 and 3, under a "Legacy Gemma setup" section, with Gemma 4 as the current flagship generation.
English only, per the model card.
The model card states it can struggle with subtle nuance, sarcasm and figurative language.
The model card states it may generate factually incorrect or outdated information.
use_cases: Content creation such as poems, scripts and marketing copy

sources.title: Gemma models overview | Google AI for Developers

notes: Google's Gemma 2-specific model_card pages (ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma2 and .../gemma2/model_card) returned 404, so the Hugging Face card under the official google/ org was used as the primary source instead. ai.google.dev/gemma/docs navigation reads "Legacy Gemma setup [Gemma 1, 2, and 3]", with Gemma 4 shown as current flagship; no page explicitly calls Gemma 2 'deprecated'. Catalog facts (8192/8192 tokens, text-only chat) match the model card and are unchanged.
